messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync: launching ISV connector bundle to cloud marketplaces + one HW partner. Focus: LangChain/LlamaIndex connector, adapter sample, SI runbook, and a joint announcement cadence. Need owners + compliance checklist.

Diego (Solutions): I'll own the connector sample and LangChain recipe. Plan: provide a repo `examples/marketplace-connector` with python/node adapters and a small demo notebook.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): For perf matrix, I'll produce benchmark numbers for three model variants (fp16, int8-q4, int8-q5) on our dedicated nodes. target metrics: throughput @ 4 concurrent streams and p95 latency.

Priya (Legal): Heads up on marketplace terms: we need a short data-processing addendum for SI customers and a partner attribution clause. I'll draft a one-pager. also: export controls check for model weights.

Erin (Marketing): For the announcement, propose a two-phase plan: (1) co-branded marketplace listing + how-to, (2) joint blog + webinar. Need draft quotes from SI/HW by EOD Fri.

Sam (Product): Question: do marketplace listings require any runtime health endpoints? If so, we should standardize `/health` and `/metadata` in the adapter.

Diego (Solutions): yes, we'll include `/health` and a `/connector-manifest` JSON with fields: name, supported_integrations, sample_rate_limit, recommended_instance. Example snippet to include in repo: ```json
{"name":"redwood-lc-connector","supported_integrations":["langchain","llamaindex"],"recommended_instance":"dedicated-g1-4"}```

Maya (Partnerships): Owners so far: Connector sample -> Diego, Benchmarks -> Nikhil, Legal doc -> Priya, Marketing plan -> Erin, Runtime contract -> Sam.

marketplace-bot: Listing template created: "Marketplace Listing Draft" assigned to Maya, Erin.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): I'll also add CI smoke tests: a lightweight `compat-check` that runs 3 prompts across LlamaIndex and LangChain adapters and verifies outputs are non-empty + latency under threshold. We'll add to GitHub Actions.

Diego (Solutions): Good call. Sample compat-check curl for docs: ```bash
curl -X POST https://connector.example/v1/compat-check -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"integration":"langchain","prompt":"summarize: the quick brown fox"}'
```

Priya (Legal): For SI onboarding checklist: corporate PO required? also need SOC2 attestation link. I can confirm which marketplace tiers require additional paperwork.

Erin (Marketing): Can we get a 5-min demo script? should show spinning up connector, running a LangChain retrieval+generate, and marketplace install flow. I'll draft slides.

Sam (Product): I'll publish the runtime contract exactly: endpoints `/health`, `/metadata`, `/orchestrate`, `/compat-check`. Schema: metadata must include `connector_version` and `supported_models`. I'll post a gist.

Maya (Partnerships): Calendar: Demo dry-run next Tue 11:00 PT. calendar-bot: Meeting created "Marketplace ISV Connector Dry-run" Tue 11:00 PT (invite: Maya, Diego, Nikhil, Erin, Sam, Priya).

Diego (Solutions): ETA for PR with example repo + README: Wed EOD. will include notebook and GH action.

Nikhil (Eng-ML): ETA for benchmark artifacts + CSV: Thu EOD. will include raw logs and summarized table.

Priya (Legal): I'll circulate draft addendum by Thu noon.

Erin (Marketing): I'll ping SI/HW contacts for quotes today. also prepping landing page copy.

Maya (Partnerships): Final checklist before dry-run: - repo PR open, - marketplace listing draft, - legal addendum draft, - benchmark CSV uploaded, - 5-min demo slides. owners above, please update this thread when items are done. Thanks! :seedling:
